content:
Alongside the early fall Prime Day deals at Amazon and the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, we have another selection of early launch week deals on Apple Watch Ultra 4 to scope out. Those offers also join the Apple refurb store with the most affordable 2026 Studio Display at $240 off, some early deals on M6 Mac mini and $50 off the 2026 Mac Studio ahead of release tomorrow. Head below for a closer look, some exclusive deals on Satechi’s charger lineup, and more.

Amazon has AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off for iPhone 18 Pro delivery day

Release day has arrived for the new Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12, with the new iPhone 18 Pro arriving on doorsteps across the country starting this morning, and what is arguably the very best accessory for all of them is still on sale – AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)

Official Apple refurb store has most affordable 2026 Studio Display at $240 off if you’re quick

We have caught some notable deals not he latest 2026 Apple Studio Display over the last couple weeks at Amazon, but the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is offering a rare deal on the most affordable model right now at $240 off the list price.

The official Apple refurb store is now offering the 2026 Apple Studio Display with the Tilt-adjustable stand down at $1,359 shipped.

  • Rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale
  • Covered by Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare product can be purchased
  • Engraving and gift wrap not available for refurbished products
  • Supplies are limited

This is the regularly $1,599 entry model Apple unleashed this past spring. It carries the standard glass treatment with the Tilt-adjustable stand and is now $240 off the new condition list price.

We suspect stock is low here so you’ll want to jump in as soon as possible if you’re interested.

For comparison’s sake, over at Amazon where it is currently fetching $1,540 and rarely sells for less, we just saw this model hit the $1,484 all-time low for the first time a couple weeks ago – it has never sold for anywhere near what we are seeing here today from the official refurb storefront.

Amazon delivering new M6 Mac mini faster than Apple, and at a lower price (Releases tomorrow)

The new 18 Pro, AirPods 5, and Apple Watch models have arrived, and AirPods Pro 3 are still $50 off, but the M6 Mac mini pre-order deals are still live ahead of release tomorrow and Amazon is shipping select models faster than Apple right now.

The new M6 Mac mini, M5 Pro mini, and the M5 Max Mac Studio are all set to finally release tomorrow. If you’re still looking to land one in the early days, Amazon not only has the lowest prices on various models, but it is also shipping them faster than Apple at this point.

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,270 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (Reg. $1,699)
  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB $2,450 (Reg. $2,499)

The Amazon pre-order deal on the 24GB/512GB M5 Pro mini has now jumped back up to the full MSRP, but we will keep an eye on it. The M6 configs and the M5 Max Studio at nearly $50 off are still rolling though.

Apple’s 2026 Mac Studio is nearly $50 off ahead of release tomorrow

Alongside the ongoing AirProds Pro 3 deal and the pre-order discounts on AirPods 5, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and Apple Watch Series 12, Amazon brought back some of the early M6 Mac mini offers and is now once again offering nearly $50 off the brand new 2026 Mac Studio ahead of release.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s new Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM and the 512GB storage capacity down at $2,449.99 shipped.

This is the base model with the 18-Core CPU and the 32-Core GPU that carries a $2,499 list price.

Amazon is, however, knocking nearly $50 off right now to entice early adopters to score it there instead of going straight to Apple. And, unless you’re trading gear in at Apple for one, you might as well keep the $50 bucks in your pocket.

Here are the Apple Watch Ultra 4 models still seeing early launch deals at Amazon

Alongside some of the early launch deal pricing on the new Series 12 we are still seeing as we move into a new work week, Amazon has also brought back the early deals on the new Apple Watch Ultra 4.

We are not seeing giant discounts or anything here, but if you are looking to land the new Apple Watch Ultra 4 in the early going here, you might as well save some lunch money while you’re at it.

If you’re not going to be trading in at the official Apple Store or Best Buy, Amazon does have the lowest prices on a few different Black Titanium and Natural Titanium configurations, including a couple with the new Translucent Ocean Band.
